headlines.text: Why the Houthi advance towards Yemen’s Marib, Taiz matters. Marib is home to Yemen's oil sector. Whoever controls it secures economic gains. Taiz's location makes it critical.
Temporary Hormuz solution deferred as Iran-Arab summit falls through. Saudi Arabia asked for the meeting to be postponed, but Tehran says it will continue to seek a regionally backed bill.
Tom Aspinall vacates UFC heavyweight title due to eye injury. Despite vacating the belt, Aspinall stresses that he is not retiring and remains determined to compete again.
US says it’s clearing Hormuz traffic: Why are oil futures beyond $100?. Brent crude crosses $107 as Hormuz disruptions and Saudi pipeline shutdown threaten global oil supply.
South Korea’s new manager Robert Moreno dismisses ‘AI coaching’ allegations. The Spanish manager has been appointed South Korea's interim head coach following a disastrous World Cup campaign.
Strait of Hormuz talks postponed due to Yemen events, says Iran. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei says Iran does not interfere in Yemeni affairs.
US may be ‘forced to intervene’ in the Red Sea. US may be 'forced to intervene' in the Red Sea
Ammonia gas leak in Jordan’s Aqaba industrial area injures 11 people. State news channel, Al-Mamlaka, says the southern port of Aqaba was evacuated as a precaution.
At least one dead, 25 missing after boat carrying migrants sinks off Greece. At least 51 people rescued as search operation continues off the island of Gavnos near Crete.
Yemen gov’t forces advance in Taiz as Houthis claim attack on Saudi Arabia. Yemeni government forces have advanced in western Taiz after successfully repelling a Houthi offensive.
Lamine Yamal says he ‘deserves’ Ballon d’Or but Mbappe his main rival. 'Mbappe and I are the two best in the world,' Yamal says before claiming he'd deserve to win the prestigious award.
South Korean officials decry ‘worst ever’ Asian Games accommodation. Organisers in Japan say they had 'neither the manpower nor the budget' to deal with the accommodation shortage.
Video: Panicked voters scramble in Philippines polling station shooting. Gunshots were heard at a polling station in the Muslim-majority Bangsamoro region of the southern Philippines.
Fashion industry leader wrestles PETA activists. Fashion industry leader wrestles PETA activists
Why Bangladesh has lost 1,000 lives to measles despite record vaccine drive. The nation has administered 20mn vaccines since April, but past slipups have led to a mounting death toll, say analysts

John Harbaugh's Giants on full display in bruising win over Cowboys to kick off NFL season. Methodic runs, more mature Jaxson Dart, and chewing clock led to a perfect start to the John Harbaugh era for the New York Giants against the Dallas Cowboys.

La Catalina ends Flammer's 1,128-day reign as AAA Reina de Reinas champion at Triplemania 34. Roxanne Perez already awaits as No. 1 contender after La Catalina ended Flammer's historic 1,128-day Reina de Reinas reign at Triplemania 34.

Giants honor 9/11 heroes before emotional Sunday Night Football opener against Cowboys. MetLife Stadium's 9/11 tribute before Giants vs. Dallas Cowboys featured the Tribute in Light, FDNY's Ladder 343 truck and a giant American flag.

Trump says China 'spies' on US after report ties Chinese imagery to Iran strike. The president said the U.S. spies on China "too" after a report linked Chinese satellite imagery to Iran's deadly July missile attack on American troops.

California football coach arrested after students make disturbing discovery at school. The Tracy Unified School District placed the educator and football coach, Jeffrey Pribble, on leave as separate criminal and district investigations continue.

Air Force colonel shot down over Iran reveals desperate prayer in 50-hour fight to survive. An Air Force colonel survived a 70-100 mph parachute fall into Iran with three broken bones and evaded enemy capture for 50 harrowing hours.

Maryland dad blamed 'Satan' after 2-month-old daughter died from horrific head trauma. A Maryland father blamed "Satan" for his 2-month-old daughter's fatal head trauma that led to her death, as he and the child's mother are facing child abuse charges.

Creepy 'Cat in the Hat' trend targets schools as costumed figure allegedly chases teen girl. A person dressed as the Cat in the Hat allegedly chased a teen girl in British Columbia as the creepy trend sparks school threats nationwide.

Jaxson Dart takes brutal hit early in Giants vs Cowboys opener but what happened next was kind of surprising. Jaxson Dart took a brutal hit from DeMarvion Overshown along the sideline, but the Giants QB avoided the blue medical tent despite his concussion history.

Mustachioed Red Sox rookie Payton Tolle opens game with immaculate inning, leaves Royals helpless. Payton Tolle struck out the Kansas City Royals' top three batters on nine pitches, throwing just the 125th immaculate inning in MLB history.

New AP Poll Top 25 punishes Ohio State, Oklahoma, Oregon, Texas jumps to No 1 after big comeback. The AP Top 25 poll reshuffled after Texas Longhorns topped Ohio State, but the Buckeyes' five-spot drop exposes a flaw in how voters weigh losses.

Missing 70-year-old hiker rescued after disappearing for a week in remote national park. A Coast Guard helicopter crew hoisted Craig Berg to safety after he went missing for a week while hiking in Michigan’s remote Isle Royale National Park.

WWE star Stephanie Vaquer captures Women's World Championship at Chile live event in surprising moment. Stephanie Vaquer stunned fans in Santiago by defeating Liv Morgan for the Women's World Championship after Becky Lynch's shocking referee turn.

Accused killers vanish after family massacre before manhunt ends hundreds of miles away. A deadly North Carolina shooting left two dead and two critically injured before suspects Camryn Moore and Cory Armstrong fled across state lines.

Celine Dion breaks down onstage during emotional return after 6-year hiatus. Celine Dion opened her 26-show Paris residency with tears of joy and a powerful promise fulfilled after six years battling stiff person syndrome.

Beijing hits back at Anthropic CEO's call to curb China's AI development. China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Monday hit back at a call from the head of Anthropic for the U.S. to curb China's artificial intelligence capabilities.

New Carlo Rovelli book challenges science's understanding of reality and the universe. In his latest book, the world-renowned physicist draws on science and philosophy to explore the notion that the university and reality are fully knowable.

ChatGPT has a feature to help those in crisis. But where can you find it?. Earlier this year, OpenAI launched a feature on ChatGPT meant to help people at risk of suicide connect with someone they trust for support. But its setup may prove challenging to someone in crisis.

Indonesia searches for 129 people missing after ferry capsizes in the Java Sea. Indonesian authorities intensified on Monday a search for people missing after a ferry overturned in bad weather in the Java Sea. At least six passengers were killed and 129 people are still missing.

Russian drone hits train near Ukraine-Poland border soon after dignitaries passed through. A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after senior visiting officials, including the former prime ministers of the U.K. and Sweden, passed through.

Amazon suspends use of 21 Air, cargo carrier whose plane careened off Miami runway. Amazon said it's decided to pause operations with 21 Air as the investigation into the crash continues. North Carolina-based 21 had flown packages for Amazon since 2024.

Pennsylvania says an unvaccinated woman has died from measles-related complications. Pennsylvania has announced its third measles-related death in less than three weeks. A local coroner says the 40-year-old woman was unvaccinated.

Trump downplays calls for AI slowdown. President Trump said the dire warnings about AI were exaggerated and that "negative forces" are making claims about things that won't happen. This comes after leaders in the industry called for putting the brakes on AI development.

Can Gulf states and Iran negotiate the Strait of Hormuz without the U.S.?. Dania Thafer of the Gulf International Forum weighs in on previously scheduled talks between Iran and Gulf states. Shortly before this interview aired, Oman announced that the talks were postponed.

Wisconsin congressman survives emergency plane landing, swims to safety. Wisconsin Congressman Tom Tiffany escaped a sinking plane and swam to shallow water after an emergency landing in a lake. Tiffany and the pilot called 911 from on top of the plane.
